25:68.text: And those who invoke not any other ilâh
along with Allâh, nor kill such person as Allâh has forbidden, except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse - and whoever does this shall receive the punishment.

25:69.text: The torment will be doubled to him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace;

25:70.text: Except those who repent and believe
, and do righteous deeds; for those, Allâh will change their sins into good deeds, and Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

25:71.text: And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds; then verily, he repents towards Allâh with true repentance.

25:72.text: And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity.

25:73.text: And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.

25:74.text: And those who say: "Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the Muttaqûn

25:75.text: Those will be rewarded with the highest place
because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect.

25:76.text: Abiding therein - excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

25:77.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to the disbelievers)
: "My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied
. So the torment will be yours for ever
